selection_method: Walk-forward evaluation across 2020-2024. Lower mean QLIKE is preferred, followed by lower stress-period MAE, MAE and RMSE.
notes: The 2025-2026 period is an additional confirmatory evaluation and is not used for model selection.
HAR-inspired features use daily returns because intraday realised-volatility data is unavailable.
OI availability is explicitly represented by the oi_available feature.
Statistical forecasts are horizon-matched and use annual expanding refits with prior-year data only.
